mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, o.location_id, o.location_code, o.location_name, o.status, o.total_items, o.counted_items, o.diff_items, o.gain_qty, o.loss_qty, o.remark, o.post_time, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM stocktaking_order o LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0

SELECT id, order_no, warehouse_id, location_id, location_code, location_name, status, total_items, counted_items, diff_items, gain_qty, loss_qty, remark, post_time, deleted, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by FROM stocktaking_order WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE stocktaking_order SET counted_items = #{countedItems}, diff_items = #{diffItems}, gain_qty = #{gainQty}, loss_qty = #{lossQty}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'COUNTING' AND deleted = 0

UPDATE stocktaking_order SET status = 'COMPLETED', counted_items = #{countedItems}, diff_items = #{diffItems}, gain_qty = #{gainQty}, loss_qty = #{lossQty}, post_time = NOW(3), update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'COUNTING' AND deleted = 0
